settings.repere: Paragraphe · With any new product it's always best to
settings.text:
With any new product it's always best to spot test 24-hours prior to application. We are not responsible for adverse reactions to product. It is the customer's responsibility to test for skin sensitivities prior to use.

How To Spot Test: Apply a small amount of product covering 1/2 to 1 inch of the inner forearm. After 24 hours if no reaction has occurred, proceed! Please do not use if you notice redness, irritation or sensitivities.
